column1: # Heart (Chalice), the Kolima secret boss. Also names rows 101 and 104.

column3:
Matthew...?
No... I know those eyes.
You came back.{page_break}I thought I'd never
see that face again.{end_wait}
My name is Isaac.\nI don't know Matthew.\nYou've mistaken me.{end_wait}

You ruined my face.
I remember every
moment of that fight.{page_break}Don't stand there
and tell me I have
the wrong person.{end_wait}
You walked away.\nI learned to hide\nwhat you left me.{end_wait}
I held back once.\nI won't make that\nmistake again, Matthew.{end_wait}
I can't make you\nbelieve me.\nBut I won't back down.{end_wait}

No... Not again.
I swore I could
face you this time.{page_break}I couldn't even look
at my own reflection
after what happened.{end_wait}
I didn't do that.\nMy name is Isaac.\nI'm sorry you were hurt.{end_wait}

Stop. Don't say
you're sorry.
You don't get to.{page_break}I know your eyes,
Matthew. I know
what you did to me.{end_wait}
Don't follow me,\nMatthew. I won't\nhear another word.{end_wait}
